methodology.disclosure: Every response in this view is synthetic. No Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, Ollama, provider key, live monitoring database or live API call was used to produce the artifact. The responses are deterministic for a fixed seed and prompt.
methodology.limitation: These charts are a controlled demonstration, not evidence about any production model. The measured statistical benchmark lives in the separate Evaluation view.
methodology.pipeline: The synthetic adapter feeds the same LLMDriftMonitor.run_monitoring_cycle() path used by a real check: response features and local embeddings are stored in a temporary SQLite database, then the configured detectors, Benjamini-Hochberg correction and consecutive-cycle alert policy decide each cycle.
